dedupe_keys.name: catastro minero de espana national mining cadastre miteco

description: The Catastro Minero is Spain's national mining cadastre, which lets users consult the investigation permits and exploitation concessions for section C and D resources under Spanish mining law. It was built by the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO) in collaboration with the autonomous communities and the Instituto Geológico y Minero de España (IGME). Coverage is national for Spain. The cadastre is consulted free through the Catastro Minero web application on the ministry's geoportal, and a download page provides the cadastral data files in Excel or CSV format. Caveats: the ministry page read is short and does not describe the fields, update cycle, geometry downloads or licence, and data depend on reporting by the autonomous communities, so completeness may vary between regions. For simulation it locates active mining rights for studies of critical raw material supply, of hazards around extraction sites, and of how mining interacts with water and transport infrastructure. It is related to the Sernageomin mining concessions cadastre record in this catalogue, the Chilean equivalent.
